qualification: Stable authority/private-root metadata and genuine captured source capabilities remain prerequisites; this is not a concurrent hostile-filesystem sandbox.
Actual protected closure/role/descriptor targets are resolved natively; closure may be external through an authenticated symlink.
File-authority target faults include required-state availability, not necessarily an independent directory-containment boundary.
Link decoder/leaf guards include early-order/diagnostic contracts where later native refusal may remain.
Injected directory occupation proves no EEXIST merge, not actual Mac case/normalization collision behavior. Native directory/file/link exclusivity is the implementation contract.

The gated-close oracle observes an opened native descriptor still held behind the test-controlled gate and API nonsettlement, then settles/closes it before teardown; it is not only an eventual-content assertion.
Links-after-files fault proves stage progress/descriptors settled before link failure, not an independent admission boundary.
Root ownership fault uses an actual permission change after successful mkdir; the parent mode is restored before assertion/fixture cleanup, and the retained created path remains visible.
Injected close-failure cases perform native closure before reporting the injected error; they do not claim an actual unconfirmed OS-close failure was induced.
Cancellation returns retained incomplete output explicitly; completed writes/chmod/close failures and release failures remain errors, even with recorded cancellation.
